title: Marcos’ 69th birthday outreach benefits over 170,000 Filipinos

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — More than 170,000 Filipinos benefited from government assistance activities held in connection with 69th birthday celebrations of President Marcos in different parts of the country this month. “Overall, we were able to benefit 175,565 beneficiaries across approximately 282 participating sites. That is why we received many letters of gratitude from our fellow Filipinos,” Marcos said in his vlog published on Sunday. The birthday activities brought together various government frontline agencies and included medical services, food distribution and other forms of assistance on Sept. 14, upon his return to Manila after he capped his two-day visit to India by […]...
